title: Lfgho-SubPay
tagline: "Lfgho-SubPay" is an Ethereum smart contract for automating and managing subscriptions using ERC20 tokens.
description:
The "Lfgho-SubPay" project is a cutting-edge smart contract developed on the Ethereum platform. Its primary function is to manage regular subscriptions using ERC20 tokens, a digital currency standard of Ethereum. This project aims to address key challenges in the field of recurrent payments, providing users with a reliable and efficient solution for automating subscription processes. It simplifies tasks related to creating, managing, and canceling subscriptions, making these processes more transparent and accessible.

Contributing to the Ethereum ecosystem, "lfgho-subscribe-payments" becomes an important tool for developers and entrepreneurs. Its flexibility and efficiency in managing subscriptions based on ERC20 tokens make it an ideal solution for integration into various services and applications. The project facilitates automated management of subscriptions and payments, making it a valuable asset in the rapidly evolving world of blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies.
how_its_made: As part of the "Lfgho-SubPay" project, we have applied React to create a dynamic and responsive user interface, ensuring smooth user interaction with the application. For integration with cryptocurrency wallets, we used WalletConnect and Connectkit, which allowed for secure and convenient connection to various user wallets. Infura serves as a reliable intermediary for accessing the Ethereum network, simplifying interaction with the blockchain, while wagmi is used for efficient management of blockchain transactions, simplifying the process of working with smart contracts and tokens.
